install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.toybox-tools"; npm install --prefix "$HOME/.toybox-tools" --no-audit --no-fund eslint@9.29.0 globals@16.3.0 playwright@1.48.2 http-server@14.1.1; "$HOME/.toybox-tools/node_modules/.bin/playwright" install chromium; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.toybox-tools/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.toybox-tools/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export NODE_PATH="$HOME/.toybox-tools/node_modules${NODE_PATH:+:$NODE_PATH}"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export NODE_PATH="$HOME/.toybox-tools/node_modules${NODE_PATH:+:$NODE_PATH}"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
